shots.content: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other. A woman in a mustard sweater sits in the plant-side window seat and begins recounting an incident, while a man in a navy button-up shirt sits in the counter-side window seat and a woman in a burgundy cardigan sits in the plant-end seat.

shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

shots.content: The woman in the mustard sweater continues the account.
shots.viewpoint: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the plant-side window seat.

shots.content: The man in the navy button-up shirt asks about the outcome.

shots.content: The woman in the mustard sweater delivers the conclusion to the man in the navy button-up shirt.
